endpoints.call: the RSS / Atom feeds (application/rss+xml, 'CryptoJobs - Latest Web3 Jobs') are usable public feeds
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. Public RSS + Atom feeds of the latest postings; no developer API; /partners is a partner-logo page. robots.txt 7 rules. No terms page linked from the home page.

search.note: crypto.jobs RSS 2.0 feed (latest 50 jobs). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<Role> at <Company>'; description (HTML) starts with Company / Location lines; category stays in raw. id is the posting link (with utm parameters).

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
